questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: Which of the following statements regarding sulphur is incorrect?

options.content: The vapour at 200<sup>o</sup>C consists mostly of S<sub>8</sub> rings
At 600<sup>o</sup>C the gas mainly consists of S<sub>2</sub> molecules
The oxidation state of sulphur is never less than +4 in its compounds
